Three separately bracketed collinear equilibria are L3left/L1between/L2right; two triangular positions(0.499,+/-sqrt3/2) form exact equilateral triangles with primaries. Circle glyphs denote the TWO physical primary references; FIVE diamond glyphs mark mathematical equilibrium LOCATIONS, not additional bodies, spacecraft or finite stability islands. External nontext key names point roles; no letters/numerals printed. Display radii10/4.2mm and diamond halfdiagonal5mm are not mass/volume/position-uncertainty scale; massratio is not inferred from glyph area. Uniform250mm/model map retains normalized geometry, with gapped axis/triangular construction guides stopping clear of glyphs, not actual trajectories, rods or force fields. Saved80decimal bisection sign brackets/residuals are independently checked; mu is not changed for fit. No all-gravity-field statement, guaranteed stability/stationkeeping or source1284unread massratio/position reconstruction. Calibration/touch/devicefit/recognitionpending."}, {"type": "Index graphic line-dot alternative", "scope": "Index1.2mm GRAPHIC LINE DOTS are a declared medium alternative, not Braille or extra scene bodies, population objects or equilibrium positions. Whole semantic glyphs, where present, retain their separately checked full native envelopes of at least6mm. Global rounded centres at least3.1mm and each native path interval at most6.2mm; true contacts, corners and native extrema protected. No physical tracing or learner-recognition approval.", "actual_phase_choices": []}], "source_limit": "Selected NORMALIZED rotating circular restricted-three-body example with muEXACT0.001 and primaries(-0.001,0),(0.999,0). Three separately bracketed collinear equilibria are L3left/L1between/L2right; two triangular positions(0.499,+/-sqrt3/2) form exact equilateral triangles with primaries. Circle glyphs denote the TWO physical primary references; FIVE diamond glyphs mark mathematical equilibrium LOCATIONS, not additional bodies, spacecraft or finite stability islands. External nontext key names point roles; no letters/numerals printed. Display radii10/4.2mm and diamond halfdiagonal5mm are not mass/volume/position-uncertainty scale; massratio is not inferred from glyph area. Uniform250mm/model map retains normalized geometry, with gapped axis/triangular construction guides stopping clear of glyphs, not actual trajectories, rods or force fields. Saved80decimal bisection sign brackets/residuals are independently checked; mu is not changed for fit. No all-gravity-field statement, guaranteed stability/stationkeeping or source1284unread massratio/position reconstruction. Calibration/touch/devicefit/recognitionpending. Illustrative nominal620x600mm page; device/page fit, touch and recognition remain pending.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}
